title: Reading, PA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Reading is a city in PA with a population of 88,000. Pretzel City with the Reading Pagoda and a strong Pennsylvania Dutch heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.7.
